facts.text: Snow left Dismal Swamp (7,050 ft) 43 days earlier this year than the midpoint of two of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 and 2025).

evidence.name: Dismal Swamp
evidence.detail: left April 29; earlier seasons: June 15 (2023), June 6 (2025); 2024: bare for less than a week so far

facts.text: At Dismal Swamp (7,050 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 6.4 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Dismal Swamp
evidence.detail: 6.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 45.6 in (2023), 36.9 in (2024), 45.4 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 4 and May 7, carried from the melt-out date at Dismal Swamp (7,050 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Dismal Swamp
evidence.detail: melted out April 29, 1,368 ft above the pass; points to March 4 to May 7
